summary: Multi-dimensional quantity picked up at the job (added to onboard load, carried onward).
range: Array of non-negative integers; dimension count must match vehicles.capacity.
businessRules: Pickups raise mid-route load; a depot-feasible load can breach capacity between pickup and a later stop (C1).

pickup defines: In case the job involves a pickup step, use this attribute to describe pickup quantity. This attribute supports multidimensional quantities, to support picking up quantities of different units/dime…
Each element in pickup must be valid and consistent with related fields.
Must stay consistent with: vehicles.capacity, jobs.delivery. Changes here may require validation of those fields.
Rule: Capacity dimensions must match across jobs, shipments, and vehicles.
Optional field. Omitting uses solver's default behavior (no penalty).
testingGuidance: Positive: pickup [2] on capacity [5] carried within the bound.
Boundary: pickup equal to capacity (pickup [5] on capacity [5]) fits.
Negative-validation: pickup dimension count != capacity dimension count -> 400.
Negative-infeasible: a single pickup exceeding every vehicle's capacity -> unassigned (capacity reason), HTTP 200.
Negative-infeasible: two pickups stacking load past capacity mid-route -> at least one unassigned.
Interaction: zero pickup [0] is always capacity-feasible (a weightless stop).
Interaction: Negative: capacity [10,100] but a job delivery [5] (1 dim vs 2) -> HTTP 400 input validation failed.
Interaction: Positive: capacity [10,100] with all deliveries/pickups/amounts 2-dimensional -> accepted.
Interaction: Consistency: alternative_capacities with different dimension than primary capacity -> HTTP 400.
Interaction: Consistency: min_stop_load [20,30] but capacity [10,100] only -> dimension mismatch HTTP 400.
